caption: The drawing depicts a painted sculpture of a man standing on a rectangular base. The man has light skin and dark brown hair styled back. He is wearing a blue long coat, a light tan or beige vest, a white collar, and bright red breeches that reach just below the knee. His shoes are black with large square buckles and he is wearing white or light gray stockings. One hand rests on his hip while the other hangs by his side. The figure stands on a stylized brown base resembling a carved wooden scroll, inscribed with the words "privateer Brigantine JOHN TARR Norfolk Virginia 1781." The overall composition is vertical, with the figure placed centrally and facing slightly to the left. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure and its base.
title: Figurehead: "Jolly Tar"
